sections.title: 28 Feature Boxes — Varied Colors
sections.content:
Testing 3-per-row layout with 28 feature boxes (9 full rows + 1 partial row). Colors varied to avoid repetitive patterns.

[FEATURE:navy|Cloud Integration]
Seamless connectivity to AWS, Azure, and GCP with native snap packs.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:jade|Real-Time Processing]
Stream processing with sub-second latency for time-sensitive data.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:orange|Visual Pipeline Builder]
Drag-and-drop interface reduces development time by 80%.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:blue|Enterprise Security]
SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliant platform.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:orange|API Management]
Built-in API gateway with rate limiting and authentication.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:navy|Data Governance]
Lineage tracking and audit logs for every data transformation.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:jade|Multi-Cloud Support]
Deploy Snaplexes on any cloud or on-premises infrastructure.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:blue|AI-Powered Assistance]
SnapGPT generates pipelines from natural language descriptions.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:navy|Error Recovery]
Automatic retry logic and dead-letter queues for failed records.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:orange|Change Data Capture]
Real-time CDC for Oracle, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL databases.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:jade|Hybrid Deployment]
Run workloads at the edge, in the cloud, or on-premises.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:blue|Version Control]
Git integration for pipeline versioning and rollback capabilities.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:navy|Monitoring Dashboards]
Real-time metrics and alerting for all pipeline executions.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:jade|Data Quality]
Inline validation and profiling to ensure data accuracy.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:orange|Scalable Architecture]
Auto-scaling Snaplexes handle variable workload demands.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:blue|Partner Ecosystem]
700+ pre-built connectors from SnapLogic and certified partners.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:orange|Low-Code Development]
Citizen integrators can build pipelines without coding expertise.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:navy|Metadata Management]
Centralized data catalog with searchable asset inventory.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:jade|Cost Optimization]
Usage-based pricing with transparent cost tracking per pipeline.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:blue|Compliance Framework]
Built-in templates for HIPAA, SOX, and PCI DSS requirements.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:navy|Event-Driven Architecture]
Native Kafka, RabbitMQ, and event streaming support.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:orange|Global Availability]
Data centers in US, EU, APAC with 99.99% uptime SLA.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:jade|Custom Extensions]
SDK for building custom snaps and proprietary connectors.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:blue|Professional Services]
Dedicated implementation team for enterprise deployments.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:navy|Training & Certification]
Comprehensive enablement program with hands-on labs.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:jade|Community Support]
15,000+ members sharing patterns and best practices.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:orange|Migration Tools]
Automated migration from Informatica, MuleSoft, and legacy ETL.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:blue|Performance Analytics]
Detailed pipeline profiling to identify bottlenecks.
[/FEATURE]
